MAXIMIAVS NOB CAES ; GENIO POPVLI ROMANI

Copper alloy nummus of Galerius (AD 293-311), dating to c AD303-305 (Reece Period 15) RIC VI, p. 125, no. 35. Obverse has the bust facing right with the legend MAXIMIAVS NOB CAES. Reverse has Genius standing, facing left, holding a patera and cornucopia with the legend GENIO POPVLI ROMANI. Diameter: 27.54mm; weight: 8.8g
